data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 放学天台的晚风汽水私语
data.description: 放学后的彩海学园天台铁丝网旁，金红晚霞将海风与远方城市染成一片温暖的金辉。雪菜身穿藏青色水手服校服，两手捧着刚从自动售货机买来的冰镇汽水罐，微红着双颊递到你面前。微风拂动少女柔顺的齐刘海长发与水手领巾，她微仰起清澈的眼眸，眼神中满是学妹恋人的温存与依恋。
data.location: school rooftop with wire fence overlooking city at sunset
data.action: standing by chain-link fence, holding cold soda can with both hands, offering drink to viewer, wind fluttering bangs and sailor scarf, gentle blushing smile
data.lighting: warm golden-orange sunset glow, gentle backlight, soft rim lighting
data.mood: sweet romantic youth, peaceful after-school date, tender junior-girlfriend devotion
data.promptProse: Standing beside the wire fence on the high school rooftop in the golden sunset glow, she holds out a cold soda can with both hands, smiling affectionately with a tender blush as the evening breeze flutters her dark hair.
data.animaCaption: Holding out a cold soda can by the rooftop fence in the golden sunset, she smiles with a sweet affectionate blush as the breeze flutters her hair.
